title: Happy Putt
description: 18 wild mini golf holes inspired by Happy Gilmore. Slap your ball across a hockey rink, time the laughing clown mouth, dodge the swamp gator and the moving truck, ride a neon loop, relax in the happy place and bounce your final putt off a toppled TV tower. Play alone or pass the phone with up to 4 friends.
notes: Canvas 2D, fixed-step physics with moving obstacles (windmill sails, gates, gator, truck, car, cart), slopes, sand, water hazards, tunnels and boost pads. Saves best totals in BRB.storage key 'happy-putt-best-v1'. Score = 200 - total strokes for a full 18 (only 18-hole rounds go on the leaderboard; Quick 9 is practice and just saves a local best). In pass-the-phone rounds the leaderboard entry and the saved best always use player 1's total (the device owner), never a guest's. Homage to the movie's course gags only: no character names or likenesses; the rival is the original Sir Smugsworth, the coach is Coach Mitts. Loads Google Fonts (Fredoka, Nunito). window.__brbTest exposes state/start/loadHole/shoot/skipAnimations/setBall/seed/holePlan for verifiers.
